description:
mupdf::page_edit::delete_page unlinks a page from the page tree but its content object stays in the saved file as an orphan, recoverable with a PDF forensics tool. This is inherent to incremental (append-only) updates: removing bytes would mean rewriting the file and invalidating every existing cross-reference.

Documented plainly at the point of use (page_edit.rs module docs) so nobody mistakes deleting a page for redacting it. The gap: kopitiam-pdf has no full-rewrite / garbage-collect save path, which is what would actually drop orphaned objects.

Worth building if PDF redaction, or merely smaller saved files after heavy editing, ever matters. Would also give us a place to flatten the accumulated incremental updates a long lecture produces.
title: Page deletion is not redaction — no garbage-collecting rewriter
